bullets.text: Kerala Congress apologized to CJI Surya Kant over a tweet demanding his resignation, acknowledging the inappropriateness of their comments.
The Central Administrative Tribunal criticized Railway officials for misrepresenting a former Solicitor General's Supreme Court undertaking.
Reliance Consumer launched Joyland Dairy Drinks, expanding its FMCG portfolio to enhance market presence.
Tax officials visited Radico Khaitan's offices amid an investigation into bulk Scotch imports under the India-UK pact.
Tata Electronics reported nearly ₹1 lakh crore in exports during FY26, marking a 29% increase from the previous year.
